The '''Haldarr Encampment'''{{co|20|61|Azshara}} was located in western [[Azshara]], northeast of [[Shadowsong Shrine]] and southwest of old [[Valormok]]. It was densely populated by [[Haldarr]] [[satyr]], the death of which is an objective of a quest.

[[Sentinel Keldara Sunblade]] laid injured, captured or was consorting here.
